scope: Descriptive integration of the five post-atlas primary Brain6 pairs only.
does_not_reestimate: global LDSC effects or original 396-family q values
fine-mapping, colocalization, QTL, or functional evidence

categories.MULTI_LAYER_SUPPORTED: Requires an inherited global signal, an admissible replication result, QC-passed promoted canonical LAVA v3 local-rg evidence, and at least one completed variant-sharing or molecular colocalization layer. All required layers must be present for the same pair.
categories.GENETIC_ONLY: Requires an inherited original-396-family significant global rg. Replication or partial-family PLACO may be shown as additional context, but without promoted local-rg and downstream variant/mechanism evidence the result remains in this category.
categories.LOCAL_ONLY: Requires a QC-passed, promoted canonical LAVA v3 local-rg result with no inherited original-396-family significant global result.
categories.REPLICATION_ONLY: Requires an admissible replication result when no inherited global signal or promoted local-rg result exists.
categories.SUGGESTIVE: Used only when the pair has available but non-significant or incomplete genetic evidence and none of the stronger categories applies.
categories.UNRESOLVED: Used when no admissible empirical evidence is available for the pair.

interpretation_limits: This is a transparent evidence-category assignment, not a numerical score or new hypothesis test.
The five-track PLACO family is incomplete because protected Track B insomnia-ADHD is absent; four pair outputs remain partial-family evidence.
Canonical LAVA v3 failed its frozen family QC and contributes no promoted local-rg results; separately versioned roundoff work is not conflated with that decision.
Directional replication is not labeled exact replication.
No missing downstream result is interpreted as a null finding.
